meta.title: YouCon – The study association for young structural engineers
meta.description: YouCon connects students and young structural engineers through site visits, theme evenings and a network in structural engineering.

home.eyebrow: Study association for young structural engineers
home.title: Build your network in structural engineering
home.intro: YouCon brings students and young structural engineers together on site, at theme evenings and over drinks. Learn from peers and discover the projects of tomorrow.

pillars.title: Site visits
pillars.text: Behind the scenes at remarkable construction projects, explained by the engineers themselves.

pillars.title: Theme evenings
pillars.text: Deep dives into current topics such as transformation, new materials and digitalisation.

pillars.title: Network
pillars.text: Meet students and young professionals from engineering firms, contractors and universities.
